title: Olympic Hall floor 4

source.what: Olympic Hall level 4 plan (CAD export) from UCLA Housing's room sign-up map site

notes: Plan: UCLA Housing's CAD export of Olympic Hall level 4 (room sign-up map, file dated 2021-04-02). Walls are its dark lines (gray level below 150); the furniture is drawn lighter and is left out. Room numbers are the plan's labels (O401...); the tracer stores the leading letter O as a zero (0401), which the site's room-key normalisation reads as 401.

Georeference: the plan footprint (the L-shaped wing plus the study-commons tower) is fitted to the mapped outline by ICP, with the same 20 degree rotation on every floor; orientation checked on floors 2 and 4 with UCLA GIS restrooms (OH227/OH262, OH427/OH456), which fall on the plan's all-gender restrooms. The housing site's north arrow (north up-left) agrees.

The exterior walls are drawn as light glazing in places, so rooms along them leaked to the outside; cuts along the mapped outline (the L wing and the tower) seal them. The outline's north block (the makerspace / upper-floor housing bar) is not cut.

Study rooms, lounges and other spaces the plan labels by name only (OPEN STUDY, GROUP STUDY, LOUNGE...) carry that name; the site's room numbers (375B/C/D, 470, 475) are not printed on the plan, so they are not assigned.
The makerspace, the outdoor stair between the wings and the site lines are not part of this floor; unlabeled spaces are recorded with kind 'other'.
